name: clean_pipefail_tee
title: Keep the test log in CI
body: Tees the test output to build/logs/test.log so the CI artifact has it; pipefail keeps the test status.
diff:
### ci/publish.sh (modified, +4/-3)
@@ -1,9 +1,10 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
-set -u
+set -uo pipefail
 
-./gradlew test
+mkdir -p build/logs
+./gradlew test 2>&1 | tee build/logs/test.log
 if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
-  echo "tests failed" >&2
+  echo "tests failed, see build/logs/test.log" >&2
   exit 1
 fi
 ./gradlew publish

files.ci/publish.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

mkdir -p build/logs
./gradlew test 2>&1 | tee build/logs/test.log
if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "tests failed, see build/logs/test.log" >&2
  exit 1
fi
./gradlew publish
